title: வேணுவனம் — சுகா
summary: Venuvanam is the Tamil writing website associated with author Suga. The homepage presents posts and categories such as essays, experiences and tributes.
content: Website title: வேணுவனம். Author name shown on homepage: சுகா. Public homepage categories include அஞ்சலி, அனுபவம், கட்டுரை and காணிநிலம் இதழ். This is a small starter index, not a complete copy of the website.

title: செண்பகமே செண்பகமே . . .

content: The homepage lists the article 'செண்பகமே செண்பகமே . . .' by சுகா, posted in the அஞ்சலி category on May 6, 2026. The article discusses Asha Bhosle and Lata Mangeshkar and their connection with Tamil film music. Use the source website for the full article.

title: கோகிலாவிலிருந்து . . .

content: The homepage lists 'கோகிலாவிலிருந்து . . .' by சுகா, posted August 21, 2024, with categories including அனுபவம் and கட்டுரை. The page discusses a film screening and memories involving filmmaker Balu Mahendra and writers. Use the source website for the full article.
